text: One large boiled egg: about seventy-eight calories and six grams of protein.
Fry it with one measured teaspoon of oil, and that teaspoon adds up to forty calories.
The protein stays about six grams; the extra energy comes from the oil, an ingredient of its own.
So measure the oil, and log it next to the egg instead of guessing.
